title: Classic
description: Time-only instruments with a calm, legible architecture. Designed to be worn every day for a very long time.

title: Toolwatches
description: Sealed cases, high-contrast dials and bezels you can actually use. Built for weather, water and unplanned days.

title: Collaborations
description: Short-run studies made with studios, publications and people whose work we follow.

title: Limited Edition
description: Numbered pieces with a fixed production run. Once the edition is closed, it does not return.

title: Accessories
description: Straps, cases and the small objects that keep a watch in use.
